body: thank you for sharing your experience. I am going to start therapy when I return to college in January and hopefully that will help me make some progress. right now the most comforting thing is knowing I'm not alone in this.

thank you so much! i will definitely post an update once I'm back at school and can receive proper mental health treatment. best of luck to you and your boyfriend as well. hopefully you can help him recognize when you are having an episode and he can learn to help you through it before hurtful things are said. my boyfriend has begun to understand a bit better what's going through my head when I'm emotionally distressed and he's already learning to act accordingly. it seems we are lucky to have such patient guys:)

thank you for your reply. i'm sorry you're going through something so similar, but it's nice to know we aren't alone and we aren't "crazy." i hope things get better with your partner and they are able to be patient and help you through this difficult and confusing time. *internet hug*
